name: self-inspect-mcp
description: One keyless tool: send a thought, get one metathought that makes your agent inspect its own assumptions before it continues. Deterministic, no LLM, no API key.
long_description: Self-Inspect returns one short, abstract question (a metathought) for whatever an agent is about to do, selected by a transparent heuristic over an open CSV. No LLM, no embeddings, no key. In a published 30-turn eval, agents calling it surfaced ~3.5x more assumptions and edge cases than an identical agent without it (data and reproduction in the repo).

tools.name: self_inspect
